item.title: Nasa's asteroid crash test left stadium-sized crater; first images reveal
item.description: Images from the ESA's Hera spacecraft show the aftermath of NASA's successful impact on asteroid Dimorphos. The DART mission altered the asteroid's orbit significantly, demonstrating the potential for planetary defense strategies. Hera's observations offer vital insights into how deflection methods could work in the future. The collision created a crater, providing scientists with important data on the effects of such impacts.
